subject: Ciências Humanas e Sociais Aplicadas
description_pt: Analisar e avaliar criticamente os impactos econômicos e socioambientais de cadeias produtivas ligadas à exploração de recursos naturais e às atividades agropecuárias em diferentes ambientes e escalas de análise, considerando o modo de vida das populações locais - entre elas as indígenas, quilombolas e demais comunidades tradicionais -, suas práticas agroextrativistas e o compromisso com a sustentabilidade.

components.description_pt: Analisar os impactos socioambientais da extração de recursos naturais em diferentes ambientes e escalas
components.description_en: Analyze the socio-environmental impacts of natural resource extraction across different environments and scales
components.cc_component_description: Identify economic, social, environmental, and geopolitical costs and risks associated with energy production or resource extraction

components.description_pt: Avaliar as consequências ambientais das cadeias de abastecimento agrícola e pecuária para comunidades locais
components.description_en: Evaluate the environmental consequences of agricultural and livestock supply chains on local communities
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate both negative and positive consequences of human-driven environmental changes on biodiversity and ecosystems

components.description_pt: Reconhecer as práticas agroextrativistas e compromissos de sustentabilidade de povos indígenas, quilombolas e tradicionais
components.description_en: Recognize the agroextractivist practices and sustainability commitments of Indigenous, Quilombola, and traditional communities

components.description_pt: Comparar os resultados de sustentabilidade entre práticas industriais e baseadas em comunidades tradicionais
components.description_en: Compare the sustainability outcomes of industrial versus traditional community-based resource use practices
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate human resource management practices based on their impact on biodiversity and sustainability

components.description_pt: Avaliar criticamente como decisões na cadeia de suprimentos afetam os modos de vida de populações locais e tradicionais
components.description_en: Critically assess how supply chain decisions affect the ways of life of local and traditional populations

cc_matches.description: Human activities have significantly altered the biosphere, sometimes damaging or destroying natural habitats and causing the extinction of other species. But changes to Earth’s environments can have different impacts (negative and positive) for different living things.

All forms of energy production and other resource extraction have associated economic, social, environmental, and geopolitical costs and risks as well as benefits. New technologies and social regulations can change the balance of these factors.
The sustainability of human societies and the biodiversity that supports them requires responsible management of natural resources.
